title: Stone Circle Pulse
style: Progressive trance with a slow hypnotic 136 BPM drive and shamanic drum pulse; deep didgeridoo duet motifs, tribal hand percussion, and rolling sub tension. Verse stays sparse with drone call-and-response between twin didgeridoos; pre-drop strips to drums and breathy overtone textures; chorus opens into layered rhythmic chants and pitched didge harmonics. Whispered ad-libs, wide stereo delay throws, reverse swells into each transition, crisp low-end and earthy ceremonial mix., low, deep, rhythmic, hypnotic, didgeridoo, slow, breathy, trance, drone
